definitionZh: 抵消的 CSS 短手属性设置了在定义路径上动画元素所需的所有属性. 抵消属性共同帮助定义抵消变换,将元素(抵消-锁定)中的点与路径(抵消-路径)上各个点(抵消-路径)上的抵消位置(抵消-位置)对齐的转变,并可选择地旋转元素(抵消-旋转)以遵循路径的方向.
sourceDefinition: The offset CSS shorthand property sets all the properties required for animating an element along a defined path. The offset properties together help to define an offset transform, a transform that aligns a point in an element (offset-anchor) to an offset position (offset-position) on a path (offset-path) at various points along the path (offset-distance) and optionally rotates the element (offset-rotate) to follow the direction of the path.
